crosswalks.historical_boundary: Medieval Artois agricultural core represented by the contiguous EU5 Lower Artois and Upper Artois historical provinces
crosswalks.resolution_method: Selected the full set of EU5 locations whose historical province field is lower_artois_province or upper_artois_province. The declared 0.96 overlap is retained as an uncertainty bound from historical county-core versus province-envelope differences; no location-level population, HYDE, RGO or starting-population field is used.

area_comparison.area_method: calibrated polygon/Jacobian area from location_candidates.parquet; historical area is the declared Artois core envelope used for this crosswalk
area_comparison.area_difference_policy: retain the difference in the anchor uncertainty; never inflate the mapped aggregate to match it

crosswalks.notes: The source's region is explicitly Artois, while the game has named Lower/Upper Artois historical provinces. This is a high-coverage regional crosswalk, not a claim that every medieval parish boundary is identical to an EU5 province boundary. Keep the record grouped by its source family and geography in all holdouts.
